messages:
Priya: Quick proposal — run a compact "mini-cohort" experiment tied to the May launch + webinar. Funnel: webinar registrants -> routed cohort A (200 starter credits, curated 3‑prompt pack, onboarding nudge series). Objective: test if a focused cohort + prompt templates lifts 7‑day activation from ~12% to >=20% and shortens time‑to‑first‑success to <30m. :rocket:
Marco: Sounds good. How are we handling attribution and routing? Need UTMs + a header so Console can break down by route. Also what's our min sample for statistical power? :mag:
Priya: We'll append ?utm_source=webinar_cohortA and set header X‑Routed: cohortA on signups. Target N per arm = 800 active signups (expect ~10% show), run for 2 weeks. Will share power calc tomorrow.
Jade: For the prompt pack, I suggest 3 templates: 1) doc‑summarize (TL;DR + bullets), 2) customer‑support triage (extract intents + escalate), 3) code‑helper (refactor assistant). I can draft them and include one‑click copy links.
Priya: Perfect — please keep each template <=120 tokens preface + example. We'll surface them on the webinar followup page.
Elaine: For the credits: ops check — can we limit to 200 credits per user, 7‑day expiry? Also add a fraud detection fallback.
Marco: 200 / 7d is fine. Suggest a lower credit fallback (50) if we see suspicious patterns from the same IP/email. Set a per‑IP cap too.
Priya: Agreed. We'll wire in fallback and caps.
growth-bot: Note: routing flag rollout scheduled to toggles/mini_cohort starting 2026‑05‑10T15:00:00Z. Monitor: "cohortA_activation" metric.
Marco: I'll create a Console card for cohortA vs baseline: median time‑to‑first‑success, activation %, cost per success, and token usage heatmap. Want it by launch.
Elaine: I'll draft the launch post + newsletter blurb using a benchmark narrative: "Fastest path to value — average 12m to first success with curated prompts" and leave placeholders for the new numbers. Need metrics by EOD Friday to finalize.
Jade: Posting the prompt drafts here in a bit. Also adding a small UX tip: include 'Try this prompt' button that autofills the prompt UI so people get immediate wins.
Priya: Plan recap: 1) routing + UTMs ready, 2) prompt pack by Jade, 3) credits/caps/fallbacks configured, 4) Console dashboard by Marco, 5) launch post copy by Elaine. Run window = 2 weeks with weekly 30m syncs. If uplift >=5pp we scale to wider webinar cohort and enable onboarding drip.
Marco: One more ops ask — tie the cohort label into billing logs so cost per success is easy to compute.
Priya: Good call, add billing tag. Thanks all — I'll follow up with the full rollout checklist and the prompt drafts once they're in. :white_check_mark:
